releaseNotes: Faster Insights — the study timeline is parsed once and cached in memory, and date lookups use cheap day-range filters, so stats screens load in a fraction of a second. Session history moved out of SharedPreferences into its own crash-safe file with a safe one-time migration (old backups restore fine). Full localization: every string (timer, Insights, settings, dialogs, notifications, widget, onboarding) is now translation-ready. Smarter writes and 43 automated tests. Includes all of 1.4.1's swipe-and-glass UI.
